summary: Discover the artistry of Italian-made colour ceramic with Studio Bagno. Crafted by skilled artisans in Civita Castellana, our collection features a rich palette of matte and glossy finishes, offering both contemporary and timeless hues. title: A Bold New Era For Bathroom Colour
bodyHtml:
The Art of Italian Colour Ceramic

Studio Bagno are specialists in Italian-made colour ceramic, offering everything from one-off bespoke statement pieces to full commercial solutions.

Handcrafted in Italy

Each piece is meticulously crafted by Artisans in Civita Castellana, Italy—a region renowned for its centuries-old ceramic expertise. This dedication to tradition and innovation results in stunning, high-quality finishes that stand the test of time.

A Palette for Every Vision

Our collection spans both contemporary and classic hues, available in ultra-chic glossy tones and tactile matte finishes.

Whether you seek to make a bold statement or simply add subtle elegance, our colour ceramic allows you to create a truly dynamic and memorable bathroom.

Seamless Matte White, Always in Stock

For those who prefer a harmonious, tactile aesthetic, our matte white ceramic is available across our basins, toilets, and bath collections—ensuring a cohesive design without the usual lead times.

Bring Colour to Life

Explore our collection and discover how colour ceramic can redefine your next project.

Click the button below, or call us on (02) 9601 1948 to organise a viewing in our showroom or one of our nationwide distributors.
